The best presents are impossible to regift.
"Your superstitions and mumblings are useless chaff before my righteousness."

—Ajani Goldmane

"I await your donation."

Exhale, and let the winds carry your soul for all eternity.

—Coruk, Esper artificer

He makes his home on the tallest mountain in Sejiri, where the vista is as endless as his patience.

Unable to touch items of value, he goes forth to steal secrets instead.

Even more than carrion, they crave the last words of the dying.

Critics were struck first by the elemental's surprising grace, and then by its fists.

Even in their mountain fortresses, the Akroans have learned not to anger Thassa.
"Time is like the Luxa River—though it flows in one direction, it can be diverted."
Every cry lifts her allies toward the thunder.
"It's an ideal method for exploring sky ruins. The drakes sniff me briefly but then lose interest."
It was built by the Witch of Lochmere. Most of the wishes it grants are its own.
"I do as I please, little mortal. Do go on about your wishes, though—they amuse me to no end."
Lives taken are lives not easily forgotten.
The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief
Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.

"We give the audience what they want."
